title: The Small Worlds Are Already Near You
excerpt: Macro photography is often sold as a trip to somewhere exotic. The photographers finding the best small subjects are mostly looking closer to home: a rotting log after rain, a garden after dark, a park they already walk every week.

title: A Free iPad Editor Worth Taking Seriously
excerpt: Affinity has arrived on iPad with its core photo, vector, and layout tools free for individuals. For photographers learning to edit, the cost of practising just dropped to zero, and that changes what you can afford to learn.

title: One Lens for the Whole Hike
excerpt: The test of a hiking lens is not a sharpness chart. It is mile twelve, when your bag is heavy, the light is fading, and changing lenses means missing the shot. That is the test one long zoom just passed on a Welsh coast walk.
